# Web Typography Skill

This repository contains an Apache-2.0 AI-agent skill for front-end web
typography.

Primary files:

- `SKILL.md`: core skill instructions.
- `assets/starter.css`: starter CSS for accessible type systems.
- `references/`: deeper guidance for typography foundations, fluid type scales,
  font loading, accessibility, modern CSS, and decision records.

Use this skill when an agent needs to improve readability, hierarchy, font
loading, responsive type, or accessible text in a web project.
